ACHIEVEMENT_3_DESCRIPTION: Selected Avatar with at least one Most Popular trait 5 times

HEADER_DESCRIPTION: Live your way! Vote your way!
HOME_FEATURE_1: • Power Vote is a game where players choose traits that make up their Avatar.
HOME_FEATURE_2: • Your task is to choose the most unique traits for your Avatar.
HOME_FEATURE_3: • There is NO random drawing - each confirmed Avatar is simultaneously a vote cast for its traits.
HOME_FEATURE_4: • At the end of the day, the traits that received the FEWEST votes will form the winning Avatar.
HOME_FEATURE_5: • The more winning (i.e., RAREST chosen) traits your Avatar has, the higher your prize!
HOME_FEATURE_6: • You can vote daily until 23:55, and voting results are announced after midnight.
HOME_NEXT_BODY: This page is a demo showing the concept and basic rules of the game. The game will be expanded upon.
HOME_TIME_TRAVEL: For the demo purposes, let's move 24h forward: Check how your avatar performed in the Results and Achievements tabs
HOME_WELCOME_BODY: Find the most unique composition, create your one-of-a-kind Avatar and vote for it.

Did you know?
A beaver's teeth grow throughout its entire life. It cuts down trees not only to build dams and lodges, but also to prevent excessive tooth growth, thus saving on dentist visits :)
SLOT_ANIMAL_ITEM_BEE_FUN_FACT:
Did you know?
A bee produces only 1/12 of a teaspoon of honey in its entire lifetime, but that's still a better contribution to a common cause than a typical participation in an office group project :)
SLOT_ANIMAL_ITEM_DOG_FUN_FACT:
Did you know?
Dogs have an excellent sense of smell. They sniff every tree on their path carefully because for them, the world smells much more interesting than any gossip portal :)
